title: Outcome of the consultation with Member States, the applicant and EFSA on the pesticide risk assessment for folpet in light of confirmatory information
text:
published: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:03:01 +0100 Outcome of the consultation with Member States, the applicant and EFSA on the pesticide risk assessment for folpet in light of confirmatory information

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) was asked by the European Commission to provide scientific assistance with respect to the risk assessment for an active substance in light of confirmatory information requested following approval in accordance with Article 6(f) of Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009. In this context EFSA's scientific views on the specific points raised during the commenting phase conducted with Member States, the applicant and EFSA on the confirmatory information and their use in the risk assessment for folpet are presented.
